---
pagetitle: "Welcome to SoCO | Society of Cutaneous Oncology"
page-layout: full
toc: false
---

<style>
:root {
  --soco-navy:#082D4D;
  --soco-blue:#0E5688;
  --soco-teal:#28A9A2;
  --soco-teal-dark:#168A8F;
  --soco-coral:#E25A4E;
  --soco-ink:#31424E;
  --soco-muted:#6B747B;
  --soco-pale:#F3F8F8;
  --soco-line:#D9E8E8;
}

.soco-thanks {
  min-height:70vh;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
  margin:0;
  border:1px solid var(--soco-line);
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 84% 18%,rgba(40,169,162,.14) 0 0,rgba(40,169,162,.14) 0 100px,transparent 101px),
    radial-gradient(circle at 12% 88%,rgba(226,90,78,.055) 0 0,rgba(226,90,78,.055) 0 120px,transparent 121px),
    linear-gradient(135deg,#ffffff 0%,#f5faf9 58%,#eef8f7 100%);
  color:var(--soco-ink);
}

.soco-thanks::after {
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  width:360px;
  height:360px;
  top:-90px;
  right:-55px;
  opacity:.16;
  background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(40,169,162,.72) 0 1.2px,transparent 1.8px);
  background-size:30px 30px;
  mask-image:radial-gradient(circle,#000 0%,transparent 72%);
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(circle,#000 0%,transparent 72%);
  pointer-events:none;
}

.soco-thanks-inner {
  position:relative;
  z-index:1;
  width:100%;
  max-width:900px;
  margin:0 auto;
  padding:clamp(5rem,10vw,8rem) 2rem;
}

.soco-thanks .soco-eyebrow {
  color:var(--soco-teal-dark);
  font-weight:800;
  letter-spacing:.12em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
}

.soco-thanks-headline {
  margin:.65rem 0 1.4rem;
  max-width:850px;
  color:var(--soco-navy)!important;
  font-size:clamp(3.3rem,6.4vw,6rem);
  line-height:.98;
  letter-spacing:-.05em;
  font-weight:750;
}

.soco-thanks-dek {
  max-width:760px;
  margin:0 0 2rem;
  color:#4d6170;
  font-size:clamp(1.15rem,2vw,1.35rem);
  line-height:1.65;
}

.soco-thanks-actions {
  display:flex;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  gap:.8rem;
  margin-top:2rem;
}

.soco-thanks-actions .btn-primary {
  background:var(--soco-blue)!important;
  border-color:var(--soco-blue)!important;
  color:#fff!important;
  box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(8,45,77,.10);
}

.soco-thanks-actions .btn-primary:hover,
.soco-thanks-actions .btn-primary:focus {
  background:var(--soco-navy)!important;
  border-color:var(--soco-navy)!important;
  color:#fff!important;
}

.soco-thanks-actions .btn-outline-light {
  border-color:#b8d7dc!important;
  color:var(--soco-blue)!important;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.82)!important;
}

.soco-thanks-actions .btn-outline-light:hover,
.soco-thanks-actions .btn-outline-light:focus {
  background:#fff!important;
  border-color:var(--soco-teal)!important;
  color:var(--soco-navy)!important;
}

@media(max-width:700px){
  .soco-thanks {
    min-height:64vh;
  }

  .soco-thanks-inner{
    padding-left:1.25rem;
    padding-right:1.25rem;
  }

  .soco-thanks::after {
    width:260px;
    height:260px;
    right:-90px;
  }
}
</style>

<div class="soco-thanks"><div class="soco-thanks-inner">
<div class="soco-eyebrow">Society of Cutaneous Oncology</div>
<h1 class="soco-thanks-headline" id="soco-welcome">Welcome to the community.</h1>
<p class="soco-thanks-dek" id="soco-welcome-message">Thank you for joining SoCO. Your information has been received. We built SoCO for people who are curious, collaborative, and willing to ask hard questions. We look forward to having you in the conversation.</p>
<div class="soco-thanks-actions">

[Return to SoCO](index.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
[Explore our philosophy](philosophy.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-light}

</div></div></div>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  try {
    const fullName = sessionStorage.getItem("socoName") || localStorage.getItem("socoName");

    /* This page is reached after a successful Netlify form POST. */
    localStorage.setItem("socoJoined", "true");
    if (fullName) localStorage.setItem("socoName", fullName);

    const headline = document.getElementById("soco-welcome");
    const message = document.getElementById("soco-welcome-message");

    if (fullName && headline) headline.textContent = "Welcome, " + fullName + ".";
    if (fullName && message) {
      message.textContent = "Great to have you aboard. We built SoCO for people who are curious, collaborative, and willing to ask hard questions. We look forward to having you in the conversation.";
    }

    sessionStorage.removeItem("socoName");
  } catch (e) {}
});
</script>
